questions.solution:

Heretical: opposite to or against the official or popular opinion, or showing no respect for the official opinion.

c) Impious: This means lacking respect for religious beliefs or not conforming to religious principles. While "impious" might have some relation to challenging religious beliefs, it doesn't capture the essence of holding views that go against established authorities.

d) Orthodox: This means adhering to established religious beliefs or traditions.

This is the most suitable antonym in the given context because "heretical" means going against established beliefs, and "orthodox" represents those established beliefs.

So, the correct antonym in this context is: d) Orthodox

In this sentence, the context revolves around the scientist's "groundbreaking research" and its impact on the field of quantum mechanics.

The word that best fits the blank and makes sense in this context is "elucidated."

a) endangered - This word means to put something at risk or in danger. It does not match the context of the sentence, as the research is not putting new possibilities at risk but rather revealing them.

b) eschewed - This word means to deliberately avoid or abstain from something. It does not align with the context of the sentence, as the research is not avoiding new possibilities but rather exploring and explaining them.

c) elucidated - This word means to clarify, explain, or make something clear. In the context of the sentence, "elucidated" perfectly fits because the groundbreaking research is uncovering and explaining new possibilities in the field of quantum mechanics.

d) encountered - This word means to come across or meet with something, often unexpectedly. While research can certainly encounter new possibilities, it doesn't capture the sense of actively revealing or explaining these possibilities, which is the focus of the sentence.

questions.question: Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow. Growth of rural economy depends primarily on infusion of capital, from time to time, to realise higher productivity in agriculture and non-agriculture sectors. As the time gestation between crop sowing and realisation of income after production is quite long, farmers borrow from various sources to meet their initial investment on seeds, fertilisers, implements and other family expenses of marriage, death, religious ceremonies etc. At the time of independence, moneylenders and traders exploited small and marginal farmers and landless labourers by lending to them on high interest rates and by manipulating the accounts to keep them in a debt-trap. A major change occurred after 1969 when India adopted social banking and multiagency approach to adequately meet the needs of rural credit. Later, the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) was set up in 1982 as an apex body to coordinate the activities of all institutions involved in the rural financing system. The Green Revolution was a harbinger of major changes in the credit system as it led to the diversification of the portfolio of rural credit towards production-oriented lending. questions.question: Read the following passage and answer the questions given after it. Science fiction is a literary universe of no mean size because science fiction is what it is, not through its content but through its background. Let me explain the difference that makes. A ‘sports story’ must have, as part of its content, some competitive activity, generally of an athletic nature. A ‘Western story’ must have, as part of its content, the nomadic life of the cowboy of the American West in the latter half of the nineteenth century. The ‘jungle story’ must have, as part of its content, the dangers implicit in a forested tropical wilderness. Take the content of any of these and place it against a background that involves a society significantly different from our own and you have not changed the nature of the story—you have merely added to it. A story may involve, not the clash of baseball and bat, or of hockey stick and puck, but of gas gun and sphere in an atmosphere enclosed on a space station under zero gravity. It is still a sports story by the strictest definition you care to make, but it is science fiction also. In place of the nomadic life of a cowboy and his horse herding cattle, you might have the nomadic life of a fish boy and his dolphin, herding his schools of mackerel and cod. It could still have the soul of a Western story and be science fiction also. In place of the Matto Grosso, you can have the jungle on a distant planet, different in key factors of the environment, with exotic dangers in atmosphere, in vegetation, in planetary characteristics never encountered on Earth. It would still be a jungle story and be science fiction also. For that matter, you needn’t confine yourself to category fiction. Take the deepest novel you can imagine, one that most amply plumbs the secret recesses of the soul and holds up a picture that illuminates nature and the human condition, and place it in a society in which interplanetary travel is common, and give it a plot which involves such travel and it is not only great literature—it is science fiction also. John W. Campbell, the late great science fiction editor, used to say that science fiction took as its domain, all conceivable societies, past and future, probable or improbable, realistic or fantastic, and dealt with all events and complications that were possible in all those societies. As for ‘mainstream fiction’ which deals with the here and now and introduces only the small novelty of make-believe events and characters, that forms only an inconsiderable fraction of the whole. questions.question: Read the following passage and answer the questions given after it. From January 28 to February 4, 2023, a Chinese-operated, large white high-altitude balloon was seen in North American airspace, including Alaska, western Canada, and the contiguous United States. The American and Canadian militaries asserted that the balloon was for surveillance, while the Chinese government maintained it was a civilian meteorological research airship that had been blown off course. Analysts said that the balloon's flight path and structural characteristics made it dissimilar from those which have typically been used for meteorological research. The U.S. Department of State said that the balloon was capable of locating electronic communication devices, including mobile phones and radios, and that American U-2 reconnaissance aircraft deployed to track the balloon in the air revealed that the balloon carried antennas and other equipment "clearly for intelligence surveillance and inconsistent with the equipment on board weather balloons." The State Department said that the spy balloon was part of a global Chinese military-directed surveillance effort in which Chinese spy balloons have flown over more than 40 nations in five continents. On February 4, the U.S. Air Force shot down the balloon over U.S. territorial waters off the coast of South Carolina, on the order of U.S. President Joe Biden. Debris from the wreckage was recovered and sent to the FBI Laboratory in Quantico, Virginia, for analysis. The incident increased U.S.-China tensions. The incident prompted U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken to delay a diplomatic visit to Beijing, which was set to be his first since 2018. It also further strained Canada–China relations, as Canada summoned the Chinese ambassador because of the violation of Canadian airspace. On February 3, the U.S. Department of Defense announced that a second Chinese balloon was passing over Latin America, which China also said belonged to it. On February 10, the Air Force shot down another aerial object over U.S. territory at the order of President Biden. According to John W. Campbell, how does science fiction differ from "mainstream fiction"?

questions.question: Which of the following principle is related to the expression mentioned in Article 13 of the Constitution of India, according to which a law is void only "to the extent of inconsistency or contravention"?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following principle is related to the expression mentioned in Article 13 of the Constitution of India, according to which a law is void only "to the extent of inconsistency or contravention"?
questions.solution:
Option C is the correct answer.

The expression mentioned in Article 13 of the Constitution of India, "to the extent of inconsistency or contravention," refers to the principle of separability.

This principle allows a court to declare a law or provision void only to the extent that it is inconsistent with or contravenes the Constitution. In other words, if a part of a law violates the Constitution, only that specific part will be considered void while the rest of the law remains valid. This principle helps preserve as much of the legislation as possible while removing the unconstitutional elements.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?

options.text: Root - Absorbs water from the soil

questions.solution:
Option A is the correct answer.

(A) Flower - Carries food: This is an incorrect match. Flowers are reproductive structures in plants that are responsible for the production of seeds through pollination and fertilization. They contain reproductive organs such as the male stamen (with anthers that produce pollen) and the female pistil (with ovary containing ovules). Flowers do not play a direct role in carrying food within the plant.

(B) Leaf - Prepares food: This is a correct match. Leaves are the primary sites for photosynthesis, a process in which plants use sunlight, carbon dioxide, and water to produce glucose (a form of sugar) and oxygen. The glucose produced in leaves serves as food for the plant.

(C) Root - Absorbs water from the soil: This is a correct match. Roots are responsible for anchoring the plant in the soil and absorbing water and nutrients from the soil. The absorbed water is transported from the roots to other parts of the plant for various physiological processes.

(D) Fruit - Protects seeds: This is a correct match. Fruits develop from the ovary of a flower after fertilization. They often protect the seeds within by providing a protective covering. Fruits also play a role in seed dispersal, aiding the seeds in being transported away from the parent plant.

Cobalt-60 (60Co) is an isotope of cobalt that is commonly used in the field of radiation therapy for the treatment of cancer. It emits gamma rays, which are high-energy photons that can penetrate tissues. These gamma rays are used to target and destroy cancerous cells while minimizing damage to surrounding healthy tissues. Cobalt-60 machines, also known as cobalt therapy units or cobalt bombs, have been historically used for radiation therapy due to their ability to deliver precise and focused radiation doses to cancerous tumors. However, more advanced technologies like linear accelerators are now commonly used for cancer treatment.

questions.solution:
Option A is the correct answer.

I. "It is a graphical representation of the relationship between price and quantity demanded." This statement is correct. The demand curve is a graphical representation that shows the relationship between the price of a product and the quantity of that product that consumers are willing and able to purchase at various price levels. It typically slopes downward to reflect the law of demand, which states that as the price of a product decreases, the quantity demanded increases, and vice versa.

II. "It gives the quantity demanded by the consumer at each price." This statement is also correct. The demand curve visually displays the quantity of a product that consumers are willing to buy at different price points. Each point on the demand curve represents a specific price-quantity combination, indicating the quantity that consumers are willing to purchase at that particular price.

Both statements I and II accurately describe the nature and purpose of the demand curve, so the correct answer is option [a] – Both I and II.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is (B) The iris contracts the pupil to allow less light to enter the eye.

In a dimly lit room, there is less available light compared to a brightly lit room. To adjust to the lower light conditions and prevent an overwhelming amount of light from entering the eye, the iris contracts the pupil. The iris is the colored part of the eye, and it controls the size of the pupil. When the iris contracts, the pupil becomes smaller, allowing less light to enter the eye.

By reducing the amount of incoming light, the eye can better adapt to the lower light levels in the dimly lit room. This process helps improve vision in low-light environments and prevents the eyes from being overwhelmed by excessive light.
